Stair Tree Choir tree wiring

One tree, seen from the front, to scale. The string runs in wiring order from pixel 1 at the base-left corner. The box (dashed, on the back face) sits with its plate 83mm in from the tree's left edge and its cover's bottom 126mm up, so the 12V plug under it ends above the bottom edge; black dots are its four ear screws and the sockets' screws, all clear of the pixel holes. The blue blocks are the three sockets (cad/parts/tree-mounts.FCStd).

Pixel layout, 92 nodes

Pixel 1 (data in)Outline 1-59Mouth 60-73Lip 74-80Eyes 81-92

Connections to the box

  • Outline: base-left, along the base, up the right edge, over the apex and down the left edge, ending at node 59.
  • Then mouth wide 60-68 (left to right), mouth small 69-73 (right to left), lip 74-80 (left to right), the viewer's right eye 81-86, the viewer's left eye 87-92. Dashed grey lines are leads that hop between groups on the back.
  • Pixel 1 takes the 5V data wire from the 74AHCT125 through R1 (33 ohm) and the JD terminal. The pixel lead leaves through the PG7 gland in the shelf and meets the tree's own lead at the xConnect plug.
  • Pixel power (about 2.1A per tree) goes from the Wagos straight to the string. 12V reaches the board only at the Mini560 input.
  • The sockets' screws go into the back face 5mm in from the edge, 12mm deep; the leads run between the pixel holes 22mm in, so keep the leads off the bottom 12mm of the back face.

Check the xConnect wire colours with a meter before powering. Clearances: docs/cad-checks.md. The board itself: electronics/README.md.
